body.name: branchmap
body.def: \(b^\star(\xi)=b\) if exactly one \(b\in\mathfrak B(\xi)\) has \(G_b(\xi)>0\), and \(b^\star(\xi)=\bot\) otherwise; thus an empty certificate set or any unresolved global tie is handled deterministically by abstention
body.role: certified deterministic selector with total tie handling
